purpose: bounded public forward evidence; no dataset qualification or economic evaluation
requested_interval: [process launch UTC, launch + 60 seconds); actual bounds recorded in capture-manifest.json
http_catalog_requests: existing factory catalog only; fallback to stubs must be reported
retries: existing bounded daemon reconnect policy within wall cap; no script restart
expected_size: 1–32 MiB estimate; observed cap can overshoot by one sampling interval
stop_conditions: SIGTERM after observation cap; SIGKILL after shutdown cap
resume: no resume; fresh directory per attempt
qualification_gates: exact values and side independent of decoder
expected_verdict: not-qualified pending missing implementation; positive raw capture may coexist with normalized defects
